_doc: Safety Sector (SS) brand configuration for the Automation Platform — the SINGLE, non-secret source of SS brand facts + design tokens. Mirrors config/brands/RDD.config.json (RDD is the reference implementation). Credentials are NEVER stored here — the SS Klaviyo key loads at runtime from Brands/SS/.env (git-ignored) under env var SS_KLAVIYO_API_KEY. Brand-prefixed env var name gives strict cross-brand isolation (a stray global KLAVIYO_API_KEY cannot resolve for SS).
_sources: Grounded in APPROVED, in-repo references (CLAUDE.md §5 — never invented): (a) 03-Brands MD Files/SS.md (approved SS brand doc, confidence-tagged); (b) approved outputs Brands/SS/Campaigns/Weekly/Output/SS-2026-W29.html + SS-2026-W30.html + the Product Launch final; (c) CLAUDE.md §6.1 (SS LEFT-aligned logo, ~120-130px sizing) and §6.12 (SS exclusions). Every value carries a confidence tag from SS.md; [Inferred]/To-be-confirmed values must be sign-off-confirmed before an SS send.
_status: PARTIAL — sufficient for Klaviyo credential resolution + isolation + live read-only validation (this integration pass). Product source (BigCommerce) is NOT yet configured for SS (no Brands/SS/.env BigCommerce creds, no integration folder); the render-quality token set is grounded-but-provisional. Full end-to-end SS drafts additionally require: SS calendar rows + an SS product source. See LIVE_SYSTEM_AUDIT / KLAVIYO_INTEGRATION_PLAN.

designTokens._note: Grounded in SS.md palette/type + approved SS outputs SS-2026-W32/W36/W38 (SS Weekly visual-system recovery, 2026-09-20 — see platform/qa/brand-visual.js). [Inferred] hex values are sampled and pending sign-off (SS.md Outstanding items). Six-digit hex only. SS house style: high-contrast black/white, single red accent, SHARP corners (0 radius) per SS.md button standard. BUTTON_BG/BUTTON_RADIUS/CTA_BUTTON_RADIUS drive ONLY the primary CTA + coupon button (Components/CTA.html, coupon.html) — the SS product-grid override (Components/product-grid.ss.html) renders price as plain ACCENT_COLOR text, not a button, so it does not read BUTTON_BG at all. FOOTER_BG/FOOTER_TEXT_COLOR/LINK_COLOR were previously #000000/#ffffff/#000000, which rendered the Unsubscribe/Privacy links in BLACK text on a BLACK footer background (invisible, CLAUDE.md §11) — corrected to the approved light footer band.

bigcommerce._note: SHARED BigCommerce store with SC (VERIFIED from project files: SS product images across the approved W29/W30 sends all resolve to store 498h0egvgn — the SAME store SC uses — served through two storefronts: safetysector.com.au for SS, sectorcare.com.au for SC). Credentials are NOT duplicated per brand: SS and SC both read the SAME git-ignored shared file (envPath below). Brand separation on the shared catalog is by brand-specific category ids (featuredCategoryIds / calendar topic_category) plus THIS brand's storeDomain for product URLs — NEVER the generic store-wide candidate/recent pool, which would mix SS and SC products. Klaviyo stays fully isolated per brand (see the klaviyo block — a shared product source does NOT mean a shared Klaviyo account). Product retrieval is blocked until the shared store's read-only token is added to the shared file, and until SS's category ids are identified from the live catalog.

klaviyo._note: Non-secret Klaviyo settings for the SS DRAFT MVP. The SS Klaviyo private key is NEVER stored here — it loads at runtime from Brands/SS/.env (git-ignored) under SS_KLAVIYO_API_KEY. Brand-prefixed env var name enforces isolation from RDD (KLAVIYO_API_KEY) and SC (SC_KLAVIYO_API_KEY). The platform creates DRAFTS ONLY (safety.js no-send guard). Fields tagged 'To be confirmed' are external prerequisites that block SS campaign creation until supplied (a verified sending domain + a dedicated test list).
